purpose: Registry of operational claims whose truth status is adjudicated by an authority rather than by how often the corpus repeats them. Ingestion tags matching evidence units with the claim key; a claim carrying a withdraws/contradicts/supersedes correction is marked withdrawn, down-ranked at retrieval, and can never be returned without its correction attached.

authorities.current-source: the claim is refuted by the code that ships today; cite file:line
authorities.task-close-note: the owning task's close record retired the claim
authorities.supervisor-decision: a supervisor decision note retired the claim
authorities.corpus: discovered during ingestion: an evidence unit that names the claim and carries a correction marker

claims.title: There is no reconciliation code path for hook-surfaced prompts

corrections.note: Current source handles SurfacingSource::HookSurfaced and stamps acked_via='hook_surfaced'. The claim is withdrawn; cas-9d92's own close record and docs/analysis/2026-08-17-historical-operational-vector-index.md carry the correction.

claims.title: Rows obtained through inbox_poll prove acknowledgement is broken

corrections.note: Inbox polling explicitly does not acknowledge; that is the documented contract with a regression test at :9582. Unacked rows reached by inbox_poll are therefore expected, not evidence of a broken ack path.
